thread:
Aisha: FYI — onboarding for ~15 tenants in the ‘early-access’ cohort is seeing an indexing/backfill lag after last night's embedding pipeline deploy. Customers are hitting slower searches and partial results. Need a short external status note + tailored outreach for 3 high-touch accounts. cc @Dmitri @Ben :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ben: How many accounts total, severity, and ETA for backfill? I can try to pull a list and surface to renewals if needed.

Dmitri: Short tech summary: root cause = autoscaler race where quantized embedding worker pods were evicted (OOM) under certain shard sizes. Deploy rolled at 02:14; we pushed a fix at 03:05 that prevents OOM at scale and added a safety throttle. Backfill job restarted at 03:20. Backfill progress: ~42% complete across affected namespaces. Expected finish 6–8 hours from now, dependent on queue. No PII impacted.

Carla: Suggest we do 2-step comms: 1) immediate incident heads-up with ETA + mitigation + link to status page; 2) personalized follow-up for high-touch tenants offering 1:1 office hours and account credits. For lower-touch, simple credit + KB link.

Aisha: Draft short status note (please review):
```
Hi <Customer name>,

We’re contacting to let you know we’re experiencing an indexing/backfill delay affecting search completeness for a subset of onboarding customers following a deployment overnight. Our engineers identified the cause and have deployed a fix; a backfill is currently running and is ~42% complete. We expect the backfill to finish within the next 6–8 hours.

What we’re doing: applying automated retries and throttles, prioritizing your jobs, and monitoring until complete.
Estimated resolution: 6–8 hours (we’ll update as it progresses).
Compensation: we’ll issue a 1-day usage credit; high-touch customers will be offered 2-day credits + a 1:1 troubleshooting session.

If you’d like a dedicated update or office hours, reply and we’ll schedule.

Thanks for your patience — Aisha, Customer Success
```

Ben: Looks good. I’ll pull the affected tenant list from the incident spreadsheet and flag which ones are tagged as renewals within 90 days. Link that sheet here when ready.

Dmitri: Small log snippet for transparency: 
```
[kubelet] eviction: memory.available < threshold
pod "embed-worker-qt-7f" evicted, restarting job shard
backfill job progress: 21/50 shards completed
```
Backfill throughput improved after fix; no further evictions seen in last 20m.

OncallBot: Incident INC-2026-1123 updated — severity LOW -> MEDIUM, updated at 1847654350.

Aisha: Outreach plan: send the immediate heads-up to all 15 affected customers in 30m. Follow-up when backfill completes with final RCA and applied credit details. For the 3 high-touch tenants (listed below), CS will draft personalized messages and schedule 1:1 office hours.
- high-touch: Acme Analytics, NovaRetail, BrightScholar
- batch recipients: other 12 tenants (uniform message + credit)

Carla: I’ll draft the personalized email for Acme and NovaRetail. @Ben can you confirm renewal status for BrightScholar — if within 60 days we escalate to AE for a call? :thinking_face:

Ben: Confirmed BrightScholar renewal in 45 days, AE handoff required. I’ll loop in Riley from sales and add to the exec note.

Aisha: Action items: 
- Ben: paste affected tenant list + renewal flags into https://tiny.redwood/incident-1847654321 (by +20m)
- Carla: draft 2 personalized emails (Acme, NovaRetail) and post here (by +45m)
- Dmitri: post final backfill completion ETA updates and confirm when 100% (monitoring)
- Aisha: send bulk heads-up and create follow-up template once Dmitri confirms completion

Carla: Also recommend offering a short training walkthrough (30m) for BrightScholar and Acme to rebuild confidence — I can prepare a 1-pager.

Aisha: Ok — I’ll send the initial note in 30m. Posting the outreach batch for review here before sending. :email:

Dmitri: Backfill now at 67% after increased worker concurrency. Will ping when at 100%.

Ben: Sheet uploaded to the doc link. I flagged renewals and added account owner contacts.

Aisha: Received — thanks. Sending first batch in 28m, high-touch drafts once Carla posts. Will update thread when backfill completes and share the formal RCA and credit transactions.

OncallBot: Next update scheduled in 60 minutes.

Carla: Posting Acme draft now — will follow with NovaRetail.

Aisha: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for customer comms edits and final sends.
